record.question: What does a high Red Cell Distribution Width (RDW) indicate?
options: All red blood cells are the same size
There is a high degree of variation in red blood cell size
record.explanation: Answer B: There is a high degree of variation in red blood cell size. RDW quantifies variation in red-cell volume (anisocytosis); it does not itself define macrocytosis or microcytosis. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK557686/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
